key_points: RTX unit Raytheon secured a multi-year $20.7B AMRAAM missile production contract under the Arsenal of Freedom initiative.
Dividend analysis favors RTX over Lockheed Martin despite lower yield, citing stronger dividend sustainability.
Recent quarterly results were strong, lifting full-year outlook per Kalkine.ca.
Analysts note improving margins could unlock additional value from RTX's backlog.
Defense modernization and rising AMRAAM demand support RTX's long-term growth prospects.
